text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":2,"why":"Patient reported having diarrhea for the last three days."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":4,"why":"Patient described loose and watery stool and pain in the lower abdomen."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":4,"why":"Patient specifically mentioned the stool is mainly watery."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":9,"why":"Patient explicitly stated there was no blood in the stool."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":14,"why":"Patient mentioned pain in the left side of the lower abdomen."},{"i":5,"v":"INFERRED","u":16,"why":"Patient described the pain as a muscular cramp."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":22,"why":"Patient reported feeling weak and shaky."},{"i":7,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Patient did not mention having a fever, but felt hot initially."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":28,"why":"Patient explicitly stated there was no sweating."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":29,"why":"Patient reported vomiting at the start but had stopped."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":33,"why":"Patient mentioned a loss of appetite."},{"i":11,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient explicitly stated he does not drink alcohol."}]}
